primary_receiver.refit: once after final outer detector, before single final decoder
primary_receiver.ce_q: latest detector APP with retained LDPC extrinsic

multiplicity: Holm over two primary cell comparisons
failed_or_missing_output: count as error; no frame deletion
practical_target: at least 20% relative FER reduction at primary deadline; effect size threshold specified before confirmation, not an IEEE requirement
minimum_evidence: one primary cell Holm-significant paired improvement, practical target, and no >0.01 absolute FER degradation in the other under the conservative one-sided 95% exact-binomial union bound specified in LOCAL_PROTOCOL.md; otherwise no positive receiver claim
stop_rules: no early stopping by observed wins or error counts
no pooled independent counting of paired arms
scope transfer is separate exploratory work unless separately preregistered
hardware_rules: BLAS/Torch thread count fixed and saved
warm every selected configuration before measurement
native comparators do not pay an I1 warm start
do not compare portable Python timings to external published GPU curves
additional_transfer_scope: Runner supports second same-length LDPC seed, rho variation by exact observation/data-unit rescaling to Pd=.5, physical path counts and same-delay collisions. Fractional delays/pulse mismatch and a different N are outside this frozen implementation. Transfer cells require explicit registration in the lock; they are not pooled with primary confirmation.
